title: Search & Website Lead
description:
**About the job**

**We're hiring: Search & Website Lead at Tekstac**

Search is changing faster than most job descriptions admit. People now get answers from AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini before they ever click a blue link. We want someone who finds that interesting rather than threatening.

**About us**

Tekstac is an enterprise skilling platform. Large organisations and GCCs use us to build workforce capability through hands-on labs, assessments, skill intelligence and AI learning paths. Our buyers are L&D and tech leaders, and they research carefully before they talk to anyone.

**The role**

You'll own tekstac.com: how it gets found, how it performs, and how well it turns visits into conversations. That means:

* **Running the WordPress site yourself.**
  Building and editing pages, fixing what breaks, keeping plugins and themes in check, and getting load times and Core Web Vitals where they should be.
* **Technical SEO.**
  Crawlability, indexing, schema, canonicals, redirects, sitemaps. You find the problem and, where you can, fix it; where you can't, you brief the developer clearly.
* **Getting cited by AI engines (AEO/GEO).**
  Structuring content so it shows up in AI Overviews, featured snippets and LLM answers, and testing what actually works rather than repeating what's trending on LinkedIn.
* **Content and keyword strategy**
  . Topic clusters and internal linking around AI skilling, GenAI and enterprise L&D. You'll work closely with whoever is writing the content.
* **Conversion.**
  Landing page improvements, GTM and GA4 setup, and a clear line from organic traffic to demo requests.
* **Authority building**
  . Earning quality links and mentions, not buying them.
* **Reporting that leads somewhere.**
  A monthly view of what moved, why, and what we do next.

**You're probably a fit if you**

* Have 5–6 years of hands-on SEO, with real ownership of at least one site's results
* Are comfortable in WordPress beyond the editor, and can read and tweak HTML/CSS
* Know GSC, GA4, GTM, and tools like Semrush, Ahrefs or Screaming Frog well
* Have run experiments on AI search visibility, even small ones, and can talk about what you learned
* Care about leads and pipeline, not just rankings

**Bonus:**
B2B SaaS, tech or EdTech background; a side project, blog or site you've grown yourself.

**Why this might be interesting**

You'll have a real website to own end to end, a small team that moves quickly, and a category (enterprise AI skilling) where the search landscape is still being written. If you've been waiting to test your AEO/GEO ideas on something that matters, this is the place.

**Location: Coimbatore**
- full-time in-office

**To apply:**
Send [lidwinc@teknoturf.com] a short note on one SEO or AI-search problem you solved, what you tried, and what happened. A link to your own site or experiment counts for more than a CV.
